newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Nov industrial output up 9.8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Nov industrial output up 9.8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: South Korea's industrial output rose 9.8 percent year-on-year in November, compared with an 8.0 percent rise a year earlier, provisional National Statistical Office figures showed on Friday.
NOTE: Year-on-year percent changes. Factory operation rate is an average for the month.
The office said November's industrial output fell 0.8 percent from the previous month, compared with a 0.7 percent month-to-month rise a year ago.
Production in the heavy-industrial and chemical sectors remained active in November, growing by 14 percent year-on-year against a 10.4 percent rise in November 1995.

The slump in the light-industrial sectors, such as textile and clothing manufacturing, deepened as output in those sectors fell 5.2 percent year-on-year in November against a 0.6 percent drop a year earlier, the office said.
Inventory growth slowed to 17.3 percent year-on-year in November, compared with a 17.7 percent rise in October and a 20.5 percent growth in September.
Inventories at semiconductor, automobile and oil refining sectors increased by 97.9 percent, 36.6 percent and 22.7 percent year-on-year, respectively.
